executiveSummary: According to these articles, a US federal judge, Indira Talwani, has for the second time blocked the implementation of a new US Postal Service rule that would restrict mail-in voting. This action came after the US Supreme Court recently ruled to lift earlier injunctions, allowing the rule to take effect. The judge issued a 14-day restraining order, citing the overwhelming risk of voter disenfranchisement and the lack of time for states to comply with the new requirements before the upcoming midterm elections.
